summary: 34 backend tests across 10 files (33 passed, 1 failed — reproducible race-condition bug) and 15 browser checks (all passed after fixing 4 stale artifacts whose selectors/assumptions predated the app's evolution to real Gemini OCR + InvoiceStudio). All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised.

bugs.criterion: Core System: OCR/AI extraction, validasi, duplicate detection, approval, arsip, dan audit trail
bugs.title: GET /api/auditpro/tax/documents 500s under concurrent load due to TOCTOU race in sync_sources()
bugs.description: routers/tax.py sync_sources() does a find_one check for an existing tax document per (source_type, source_id) and only inserts if absent. This check-then-insert is not atomic: when two requests to GET /auditpro/tax/documents arrive close together after a new approved transaction/invoice exists, both can pass the 'not yet synced' check and then race on the unique (source_type, source_id) index. The losing request gets an unhandled pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError -> unhandled 500 instead of idempotently returning the already-synced document. Reproduced deterministically with 6 concurrent GETs after approving a fresh transaction (both via raw curl against :8001 and via a dedicated pytest using httpx.AsyncClient).
bugs.evidence: backend test tests/test_tscheck_tax_sync_race_condition.py::test_concurrent_tax_document_sync_does_not_500 — created tscheck-race-vendor-<suffix> transaction, submitted+approved it, fired 6 concurrent GET /auditpro/tax/documents; result on 2 separate runs: statuses=[200,200,500,200,200,200] and [200,200,200,200,200,500]. Backend log: pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError: E11000 duplicate key error collection: app.audit_tax_documents index: tax_source dup key {source_type: 'transaction', source_id: '...'}. Also observed live via browser regression check (console error '500 (Internal Server Error)' on GET /api/auditpro/tax/documents while navigating nav items in rapid succession on the public preview URL).

action_items.criterion: Piutang dan pembayaran: aging bucket, reminder, dan tracking pembayaran
action_items.note: Receivables total is a single aggregate (sum of sent+overdue invoice totals, verified consistent between /dashboard and /reports/summary). No aging bucket, no partial-payment ledger, no reminder/follow-up workflow fields exist on the Invoice schema (confirmed absent: aging_bucket, amount_paid, reminder_sent_at, payments). The 'Piutang' nav item is an explicit preview shell ('Demo mode' badge) per seed_facts — this matches spec_deviations, not a regression.

action_items.criterion: Enterprise features: authentication, role permission, admin aggregate dashboard, smart approvals, enterprise security, predictive analytics
action_items.note: No login, no auth middleware, no role/permission fields anywhere in the Transaction/Invoice schemas. Every endpoint tested accepts anonymous requests (dashboard, transactions GET/POST, tax/summary). This matches seed_facts ('Aplikasi tidak memiliki login') and spec_deviations (Tahap 5 not implemented) — reported as a declared gap, not a defect.

action_items.criterion: Sales & Finance: dashboard penjualan, sales report, filter periode
action_items.note: The dashboard chart's 'Filter periode' control only shows a static toast ('Filter periode: 6 bulan terakhir'); it does not change the displayed data. The Reports view shows a fixed period label with no date-range inputs. The backend DOES support start/end query params on /reports/summary (verified via curl), but no UI surfaces them — period filtering is not actually usable from the UI today.
e-Faktur export is CSV preview only (no DJP integration); no email-invoice or external business integrations beyond Gemini were found in routers or UI. Matches spec_deviations.

4 pre-existing check artifacts (documents-ai-extraction, document-transaction-validation, invoice-draft-creation, financial-assistant-chat, dashboard-overview-renders, tests/test_tscheck_document_extraction.py, test_tscheck_document_validation.py, test_tscheck_dashboard.py, test_tscheck_invoice_creation.py) were authored against an earlier mocked/placeholder version of the app (fake OCR text buffer, legacy flat invoice table, hardcoded global dashboard numbers). They were updated in this iteration to match the current real-Gemini-OCR / InvoiceStudio / database-derived-metrics implementation, per seed_facts warning that global counts/values must not be assumed fixed.
